comparison.objective: Rotate and lay two plasterboards across ceiling joists with both ends supported; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-board reorientation and support-aware placement versus millimetre-scale mandrel alignment, hammering, fracture regulation, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Each board square across joists with both ends landing on a joist versus four valid fractures and contained fragments with retained components intact.
comparison.reason: The physical scale, mechanism, and tested placement outcome are materially different.
